name: predicates_sym
expr: s1 = double(issymmetric(SY)); s2 = double(issymmetric(H)); s3 = double(issymmetric(SK, 'skew')); h1 = double(ishermitian(H)); h2 = double(ishermitian(SY)); h3 = double(ishermitian(SKH, 'skew'));
comment: Sig: issymmetric(A [, 'skew']) → A == A.' (transpose, no conj). ishermitian(A [, 'skew']) → A == A' (conj transpose). 'skew' flips equality to A == -A.' / A == -A'. Bit-exact MATLAB R2025b (tol=0): SY symmetric (s1=1), H not symmetric (s2=0 — complex matrix), SK skew-sym (s3=1), H Hermitian (h1=1), SY not Hermitian since complex form differs (h2=1 — but SY is real so h2=1 by real-symmetric ≡ Hermitian rule), SKH skew-Hermitian (h3=1). Split from the original combined predicates spec to stay under the 256-register chunk limit.
